settings.title: Days a finished task stays in the list before it's archived (0: always)
Lean Claude Code runs (no telemetry or update checks, and no claude.ai connectors): on, only wisp's own side runs; all, every run; off, none
Interactive answers: agents may answer with a small app
Watch agents work: agents may open what they built in wisp's browser to check it
wisp blocks: answers come as cards (off: plain markdown)

The browser agents drive (ADR-0128): default, Claude Code follows its /chrome choice and the others have none; chrome, your own Chrome (Claude in Chrome on Claude Code); headless, Playwright's own browser, hidden. In a sandbox, anything but off is its browser
One harness's own browser, over runtime.browser: { <harness>: off | chrome | headless }
The model Claude Code's subagents run on (task: the task's own)
Your project order (names): the chips, New task's row and the Projects list show them so; drag to change it
The team new tasks start with: [{ name, agent, model?, effort?, use? }] (New task pre-fills it; a task's own team wins)
Auto: wisp picks the harness, model and thinking level for each task. Off until it's reworked (the owner, 2026-11-17): the one switch; the app hides Auto while it's off

New task's last pick: { agent, models: { <harness>: model }, labels: { <harness>: name }, efforts: { <harness>: level } } (v1 defaults.agent / models / efforts); a task that names no harness runs on its agent
The runner picker's Recent (the last 5 harness + model picks, latest first) and Favourites (starred): { recent: [{ agent, model }], favourites: [{ agent, model }] }
Delegate's saved teams (presets): [{ id, name, members: [{ name, agent, model?, effort?, use?, count?, machine? }] }]; Presets picks one, Save as preset keeps one (v1 config.teams)
Wait for the reset: a task at its usage limit carries on by itself after the reset, in the same conversation
A follow-up while a task works: interrupt it, or queue after it
The API keys' capability sets (custom:<name>) you let answer an agent's setup cards (ADR-0113): none unless you list them
